critique: The render passes both acceptance tests: the ISO reads instantly as an open-frame FPGA NTT card — eight glass BRAM banks down the back edge, the copper DSP-multiplier column, the symmetric add/sub pairs in an open rail-and-floor frame, the exploded radix-4 BU and the ten-fin heatsink both lifted clear on visible risers, and FRONT/SIDE show nothing sunk below or floating off the ground line; the prior heatsink-clearance worry is resolved (the fins sit well clear of the Barrett spine and the +X register column). The one real, fixable defect is NOT geometric but an internal annotation contradiction the prior pass flagged: the scene simultaneously committed the GF(2) XOR-fold conflict-free map (which fixes the stride-512 collision) AND still literally cited the buggy additive map b(i)=(i+(i>>3)) mod 8 in crossbar_network/addr_gen_unit/bram role+params, so a rebuilder reading the human-facing text would implement the colliding map. The remaining deficits are source-transcription gaps (the paper's actual Sec. III bank/offset functions, sigma_s routing, twiddle-ROM addressing and DIT/DIF ordering are reproduction reconstructions, not the untranscribed source) which the evidence/amend loop must pin, plus sub-2-pt polish in the dense central plan view.
